request: Advanced-route deliverable: post-disaster grant velocity. Pull FEMA Disaster Declaration Summaries for the last 24 months (declarationDate > 2024-07-24) as the F1 anchor. Enrich with days_since_declaration, days_open. Publish two DSes to Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent. Grant-side joins to 'SLED Grants FY24 Detail' + 'USASpending SLED Grants' + 'Fed Outlays' happen at dashboard time — this is the 4-DS join demo.

sources.name: FEMA Disaster Declarations 24mo
sources.description: OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries v2 filtered to declarationDate > 2024-07-24 (24mo window). Each row = one declaration (county-level granularity). OData v2 pagination.

args.name: Post Disaster Velocity Trend
args.features_description: FEMA declaration anchor rows keyed on disasterNumber + state + declarationDate with days_since_declaration and days_open. Join at Tableau layer to: (a) 'SLED Grants FY24 Detail' filtered to Start Date in [declarationDate, declarationDate+90d] on state for F2 post-declaration grant $; (b) same DS at (declarationDate-365d, declarationDate) monthly average for F3 baseline; compute velocity_ratio = F2 / (F3 * 3). First-grant lag = min(Start Date - declarationDate) in the same state within 90d.
args.stats_description: Per-(state, incidentType) declaration rate stats for 24mo window. Monthly counts, 30d rolling, z-score anomalies flag surges in declarations (e.g., hurricane season peaks).

outputs.name: Post Disaster Anchor Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level FEMA disaster declarations from the last 24 months (declarationDate > 2024-07-24) enriched with days_since_declaration, days_open. Fields include femaDeclarationString, disasterNumber, state, declarationType, declarationDate, fyDeclared, incidentType, declarationTitle, incidentBeginDate/EndDate, disasterCloseoutDate, tribalRequest, fipsStateCode, fipsCountyCode, designatedArea, ih/ia/pa/hmProgramDeclared flags, and calendar features. Refresh: daily.

Advanced-route notes: this is the FEMA-ANCHOR leg of a 4-DS post-disaster grant velocity view. Grant-side joins happen at Tableau layer to: (a) 'SLED Grants FY24 Detail' + 'USASpending SLED Grants'; (b) 'Fed Outlays' baseline context. Post-declaration grant velocity is TEMPORAL CORRELATION not causation — CFDA / HMGP program-code crosswalk is not on-site, so we cannot tag which grants are recovery-specific vs unrelated renewals. Major disaster declarations only (DR-prefix).

outputs.name: Post Disaster Trend Stats
outputs.description: Per-(state, incidentType) declaration statistics for the 24mo window: monthly counts, 30d rolling, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot hurricane / wildfire seasonal surges.
